cells.claim: Tryton's source-native object is party.party (Party); the party module does not name this model Customer.
party.party relates to party.address through Addresses and to party.contact_mechanism through Contact Mechanisms.
Party.copy copies parties and resets the copied code through its default mapping.
Party Code is a required input; Full Name and contact-mechanism Function fields are observable derived outputs.
party.party is DeactivableMixin-based; this complete selected model declaration does not define a Workflow state selection or transitions.
counterexamples: Do not normalize DeactivableMixin active/inactive behavior into a sales-style workflow.

cells.claim: ContactMechanism.on_change_address assigns the Address party when Address changes.
party.contact_mechanism requires Party; deleting Party cascades to the contact mechanism.
party.party enforces the code_uniq SQL constraint on Code.
Setting an already exposed Party contact mechanism raises AccessError with party.msg_party_set_contact_mechanism.
Party readback uses Name as rec_name, or the bracketed Code when Name is empty.
trytond exposes an RPC route and dynamic dispatch, but this source does not document a Party-specific service contract.
counterexamples: Generic trytond RPC exposure is not evidence of a Party-specific documented API.

cells.claim: sale.sale requires party.party as Party; no distinct Customer model is evidenced in the complete selected Party and Sale semantic members.
counterexamples: The role played in a sale must remain Party and must not be rewritten as a separate Customer object.

class Sale(
        Workflow, ModelSQL, ModelView, TaxableMixin,
        AttachmentCopyMixin, NoteCopyMixin, ChatMixin):
    __name__ = 'sale.sale'
cells.claim: Tryton's source-native sales object is sale.sale (Sale), with sale.line records and Party participation.
sale.sale relates to sale.line through Lines and exposes Invoices, Shipments, Shipment Returns and Stock Moves.
Sale operations include quote, confirm, cancel, draft and process; process handles invoice, fulfillment and state updates.
Sale inputs include required Company, Party and Currency plus Lines; outputs include Number, amounts, invoices, shipments and states.
Sale State is exactly Draft, Quotation, Confirmed, Processing, Done or Cancelled, with the source transition set declared by Sale.__setup__.
Confirm schedules Sale.process through cls.__queue__ using sale_process_after and queue context.
Quote calls check_for_quotation before setting Quotation Date and Number; process filters to Confirmed, Processing or Done.
